title: Inside GTA 6's Vice City: Ocean Beach, Little Cuba and a Bootleg Flea Market 🌴 #Shorts
description:
Rockstar's official Vice City postcard calls it "the sun and fun capital of America": Ocean Beach (pastel art deco hotels, bright white sands), Little Cuba (bustling panaderías), the Tisha-Wocka flea market (bootleg brands) and VC Port ("the cruise ship capital of the world"). Footage is from the official trailers and does not necessarily show each named spot.

Source: rockstargames.com/VI
Fan channel, not affiliated with Rockstar Games.
